text:
maria: Quick sync: planning a short "velocity" experiment for next product push. core idea: 1) give a small credit bundle, 2) surface 3 ultra-short prompts (one-liner each), 3) invite to a 20-min how-to demo. goal: speed to first "aha" in <24h and measurable lift in retention. thoughts?
ashley: love the compact approach. suggest two creative lanes: "build-fast" (code snippets) and "write-fast" (marketing prompts). cheap demos for both.
jon: segmentation suggestion: use 'signup_intent' + first-run model selection. map to prompt lane. simple rule: if wants embeddings -> show embed lane, else show gen lane.
sam: ops check: can we gate the credits to new accounts only and auto-expire them at 7 days? low risk.
maria: yes 7d expiry. credit amount: 20 credits. small enough to control cost but enough for 1-2 useful tries.
leo: short webinar plan: 10m show-and-tell, 7m live prompt walkthrough (3 prompts), 3m q&a. record and include 30s highlight clip.
ashley: subject lines to test: "20 credits to try Redwood in 3 mins", "Try these 3 prompts — free credits inside". A/B the two.
jon: metric defs: activation = first_success event (user gets output they mark as "useful" or hits quick follow-up). retention slice = +7d active. cost metric: avg token cost per activated user.
maria: cadence proposal: 0h email + credits, 4h in-app nudge w/ CTA, 18h reminder + webinar invite, 48h last-chance credit expiration. can we compress to 48h active window?
sam: yes, 48h window is fine. infra tasks: create experiment flag welcome_micro_v1, throttle new user tokens to 75rpm default, log events: credit_granted, prompt_used, first_success.
maria: prompt pack constraints: 3 prompts max. each prompt must include a short "seed input example" and an expected-use-case sentence. store in PromptPack_2026_04 (immutable).
leo: for the embed lane show a tiny visual demo — 20s gif — and link to the playground. that lowers cost and shows search value.
ashley: landing page microcopy: highlight fast wins: "3 prompts, 3 minutes, one result that helps you ship". add social proof line about latency/cost savings.
jon: routing: default model = cost-optimized-small-gen; embedding route = small-embed-v1; fallback -> hosted-standard-gen. include model_name in analytics.
sam: rollout plan: start 8am Fri, 10% traffic for 24h, watch first_success rate, ramp to 35% if no regression. set alerts: if cost per activation > $1 or first_success < 25% after 24h, pause.
maria: tracking: event names: welcome_sent, credits_claimed, prompt_pack_opened, prompt_executed, first_success, webinar_registered. tag events with cohort & variant (emailA/emailB).
ashley: creative deliverables: emailA/emailB, in-app nudge copy (short), 20s demo gif for embed lane, 3 prompt texts + seed inputs. i'll deliver by Thu EOD.
jon: I'll draft the seg mapping rules and QA the analytics keys.
sam: i'll wire experiment flag + quotas + alerts. will post runbook snippet here once done.
maria: runbook priority items: 1) rollback path (disable credits), 2) throttle increase plan, 3) who to call if infra spikes (oncall + eng-runtime).
leo: webinar ops: set up auto-register and a short follow-up with clip + transcript snippet. include CTA to "use your credits" in follow-up.
ashley: small UX suggestion: show expiration countdown inside product header during first session. drives urgency.
maria: ok team. timeline: drafts by Thu, infra ready Fri morning, soft-launch 10% Fri 8am PT. we'll review results Mon sync.
jon: noted. I'll add a field in the signup flow to capture 'primary use' to improve routing.
sam: growth-bot: experiment created welcome_micro_v1 id: exp_20260412_2. traffic: 10% initial. auto-ramp rules set.
ashley: :rocket: excited to see numbers.
maria: thanks all, i'll drop the prompt-pack drafts below when ready. keep replies short so we can move fast.
